item.title: Hello, world
item.description:
This is the first post. It exists to show what a post looks like once it's built: a title, a byline with the date, and a body written in a small subset of Markdown — paragraphs, bold, italics, inline code, links, block quotes, and simple lists.

Style is not neutral; it is ideological, and the plainness of this page is a choice as much as any other.

Some things this template deliberately does not have: hero images, card grids, animated transitions, a cookie banner, a newsletter popup, or a "reading time" estimate. Just a title, a date, and the text.

To add a new post, drop another .md file into content/posts/ with the same front matter block, then run:

python3 build.py

  • edit content/config.json for the site title, tagline, and about blurb
  • edit content/about.md for the about page
  • edit templates/base.html for the blogroll links in the sidebar
